title: The Course Format Converter
description: Converts a course from one format to another — in-person to async online, semester to compressed, lecture-heavy to flipped — preserving learning outcomes while restructuring delivery.
framing_paragraph: This recipe defines The Course Format Converter, a teaching-focused agent that fits the use case in the description above. Use it when that description matches what you want the agent to do in your course. The agent works best when its Instructions field is calibrated against two or three representative prompts before you share the resulting agent with students or colleagues.

recommended_platforms.comparative_phrase: Claude or ChatGPT (Projects) for moderate-sized · decent on Copilot
recommended_platforms.tradeoff_subline: Gemini's very large context window holds an entire semester's materials simultaneously. Claude and ChatGPT Projects work well for moderate courses. Copilot can do conversions on smaller courses but may lose fidelity on very large ones.
